answer: Decaying identity bonds stop sybil farms. Each new identity posts a 300 POA bond losing 5% of its value every idle epoch; only real attested work refreshes it. A bond left to wander shrinks toward zero, while an anchor identity at work keeps it whole. 100 fakes cost 30,000 POA and bleed 1,500 POA per idle epoch. A vertex is only as strong as its live bond, so honest agents pay once and keep earning, while a sybil army keeps buying fresh bonds.
